samples.question: The upper and lower cyan-framed mosaics use the same 5-by-5 cell coordinates. In each row of the gold middle key, its one gold dot marks the last column to take from the upper mosaic. Build a 5-by-5 result by taking that row's cells through the marked column from the upper mosaic and all cells strictly to its right from the lower mosaic. Keep every cell in its original position; do not rotate or reflect. Which coral reference card matches? Cards A, B, C, and D are in reading order: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right.
